readme.excerpt:
Your job search, on your own server: one profile, a tailored resume and cover letter for every job, and every application tracked from draft to offer.

Dossier keeps your career history in one profile and turns it into a clean resume. For every job you apply to, it reads the posting, shows how you match, and drafts a tailored resume and cover letter that only use facts from your profile. You refine them in a chat, download them as PDFs and track each application from draft to offer.

It's for one person on a small server: one password, your data in your own PostgreSQL database, and an AI model of your choice. That can be a local model through Ollama or LM Studio, so your profile and documents stay on your own hardware, or a hosted one (any OpenAI-compatible API, Anthropic or Mistral), which then receives what it writes from. Privacy says what goes where.

readme.excerpt:
一、项目理念 ：紫微斗数是中国传统命理学的瑰宝，倪海厦老师在《天纪》中系统梳理了正宗的紫微斗数体系。我们希望通过技术手段让更多人接触和学习这门学问。

开源排盘算法和知识库，是因为我们相信： 算法是公开的传统智慧，不应该被锁在围墙里 。真正的价值在于解读的深度、用户体验的打磨、以及持续运营的积累。

二、项目信息 ：基于 倪海厦《天纪》 教学体系的紫微斗数排盘系统，包含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据，以及一套完整开源的紫微斗数解读数据： v4.0 解读数据集——67.5 万张命盘 × 13 维 = 877 万段解读，正文约 204 亿字，解压后 56.6 GB （2026-10-15 发布）。
features: 标着倪师或《全书》却查不到出处的引文，删掉或换成逐字可查的原话；倪师原话注明《天纪》第几集、几分几秒
不会发生的四化（如七杀化权、紫微化忌）相关的句子删去；只在某种条件下才成立的断语补上条件
「力量强时……落陷时……」这类两头说的句子，改为按命盘只显示成立的那一种
健康：哪个脏腑要留意，改按倪师的看法——全盘杀星最集中的那一宫，按它的地支对应脏腑；不再按星的五行推脏器
网站知识库「古籍引证」由 244 处增至 405 处，每一处都能在《紫微斗数全书》原文里逐字找到
是本命盘视图的解读；网站上按读者当前年龄改写的句子、各维末尾附加的倪师法则段、AI 解读都不在数据集里。
按时辰序号直接排盘，未按出生地做真太阳时校正。
微调小模型的训练语料（51.8 万 input-output 配对）

items.name: ESP32-Bit-Pirate
items.description: A Hardware Hacking Tool with Web-Based CLI That Speaks Every Protocol

readme.excerpt:
ESP32 Bit Pirate is open-source firmware that turns your device into a multi-protocol development and analysis tool, inspired by the legendary Bus Pirate.

It supports sniffing, sending, scripting, and interacting with various digital protocols (I2C, UART, 1-Wire, SPI, etc.) via a serial terminal or web-based CLI. It also communicates with radio protocols like Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Sub-GHz, LoRa and RFID.

The official project website centralizes everything: ESP32 Bit Pirate Website.
features: Interactive command-line interface (CLI) via USB Serial or WiFi Web .
Modes for:
HiZ (default)
I2C (scan, glitch, slave mode, dump, eeprom)
SPI (eeprom, flash, sdcard, slave mode)
UART / Half-Duplex UART (bridge, read, write)
1WIRE (ibutton, eeprom)
2WIRE (sniff, smartcard) / 3WIRE (eeprom)
